item.title: The Whistle: Root Through a Mail Gateway, an Intrusion Run on 51 Agents, and Deno's Clock Starts
item.description: The appliance beat returned to the top this week: a mail gateway and a VPN, both rooted through unauthenticated bugs that were in use before they had fixes. Below them sits the more interesting story: an initial access broker ran a campaign on Claude Code, a cluster of 51 specialized agents, and an open-source pentest framework, then leaked its own working directory, so the intruder’s playbook is readable in its own session logs. Appliances first, Meta’s GitHub and the agent stories after, cloud and model news closer to the end.
